camel_example: aliyun ecs ImportImage --region cn-hangzhou --DetectionStrategy Standard --DiskDeviceMapping.1.DiskImageSize 80 --Features.ImdsSupport v2 --Tag.1.Key TestKey --Description TestDescription --Architecture x86_64 --Platform Aliyun --ResourceGroupId 'rg-bp67acfmxazb4p0000' --DiskDeviceMapping.1.Device 'example-string' --BootMode BIOS --StorageLocationArn 'arn:acs:cloudbox:cn-hangzhou:123456:cloudbox/cb-xx000123' --DryRun false --DiskDeviceMapping.1.OSSObject 'CentOS_5.4_32.raw' --DiskDeviceMapping.1.DiskImSize 80 --LicenseType BYOL --Features.NvmeSupport supported --ImageName ImageTestName --DiskDeviceMapping.1.Format QCOW2 --RoleName AliyunECSImageImportDefaultRole --OSType linux --Tag.1.Value TestValue --DiskDeviceMapping.1.OSSBucket ecsimageos --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou' --ClientToken '123e4567-e89b-12d3-a456-426655440000' --method POST --force
description_en: Imports a local image file to Elastic Compute Service (ECS) as a custom image that appears in the specified region. You can then use the imported image to create ECS instances (RunInstances) or replace the system disk of an instance (ReplaceSystemDisk)
description_zh: 导入一份您的本地镜像文件到云服务器ECS，作为自定义镜像出现在相应地域中。后续您可以使用导入的镜像创建ECS实例（RunInstances），或者更换实例的系统盘（ReplaceSystemDisk）
kebab_example: aliyun ecs import-image --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --image-name ImageTestName --description TestDescription --architecture x86_64 --os-type linux --platform Aliyun --boot-mode BIOS --role-name AliyunECSImageImportDefaultRole --license-type BYOL --resource-group-id rg-bp67acfmxazb4p0000 --disk-device-mapping Format=QCOW2 OSSObject=CentOS_5.4_32.raw Device=example-string DiskImSize=80 DiskImageSize=80 OSSBucket=ecsimageos --tag Value=TestValue Key=TestKey --detection-strategy Standard --storage-location-arn arn:acs:cloudbox:cn-hangzhou:123456:cloudbox/cb-xx000123 --dry-run false --features NvmeSupport=supported ImdsSupport=v2 --client-token 123e4567-e89b-12d3-a456-426655440000 --region cn-hangzhou

parameters.help_en: The image name. The name must be 2 to 128 characters in length. It must start with a letter or a Chinese character and cannot start with `aliyun` or `acs:`. It cannot contain `http://` or `https://`. It can contain digits, periods (.), colons (:), underscores (_), or hyphens (-)
parameters.help_zh: 镜像名称。长度为2~128个字符。必须以大小写字母或中文开头，不能以`aliyun`或`acs:`开头，不能包含`http://`或者`https://`。可以包含数字、半角句号（.）、半角冒号（:）、下划线（_）或者短划线（-）

parameters.help_en:
The boot mode of the image. Valid values:

BIOS: Basic Input/Output System (BIOS) boot mode.
UEFI: Unified Extensible Firmware Interface (UEFI) boot mode.

Default value: BIOS. If `Architecture=arm64`, the default value is UEFI, and only UEFI can be specified.

<notice>

To prevent instances from failing to start due to an unsupported boot mode, make sure that you understand the boot mode supported by the target image before you specify this parameter. For more information about image boot modes, see [Image boot modes](~~2244655#b9caa9b8bb1wf~~).

</notice>
parameters.help_zh:

BIOS：BIOS启动模式。
UEFI：UEFI启动模式。

默认值：BIOS。如果`Architecture=arm64`，则该参数默认值为UEFI，且只能设置为UEFI。

<notice>

为了避免使用镜像不支持的启动模式导致实例无法正常启动，请您务必在选择该参数之前了解目标镜像支持的启动模式。镜像启动模式详情，请参见[镜像启动模式](~~2244655#b9caa9b8bb1wf~~)。

</notice>

parameters.help_en:
The license type. This parameter specifies the authorization mode when instances are created by calling https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2679677.html with this image. This value takes effect only for Windows Server images. Valid values:
Aliyun: Uses the Alibaba Cloud official license. After the instance starts, the system attempts to automatically connect to the Alibaba Cloud KMS server for activation. The billing for the instance includes the Windows Server license fee.
BYOL: Bring Your Own License. After the instance starts, Alibaba Cloud does not automatically activate it. You must manually activate it by using your own valid license key. The billing for the instance does not include the Windows Server license fee.

Default value: Aliyun
parameters.help_zh:
许可证类型，预设该镜像在创建实例（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2679677.html）时的授权模式。该值仅对 Windows Server 类型镜像生效。取值范围：
Aliyun：使用阿里云官方许可。启动实例后，系统将尝试自动连接阿里云 KMS 服务器进行激活。该实例的计费中将包含 Windows Server许可费。
BYOL：自带许可 (Bring Your Own License)。启动实例后，阿里云不会对其进行自动激活。您需使用自有的合法许可密钥手动激活。该实例的计费中不会包含 Windows Server许可费。

默认值：Aliyun
parameters.name: license_type

fields.help_en:
The device name of DiskDeviceMapping.N.Device in the custom image.

This parameter will be deprecated. For better code compatibility, do not use this parameter
fields.help_zh:
指定DiskDeviceMapping.N.Device在自定义镜像中的设备名。

该参数即将停止使用，为提高代码兼容性，建议您尽量不要使用该参数
fields.name: device

fields.help_en:
The size of the custom image. Unit: GiB.

The space consists of the system disk and data disks. Make sure that the system disk space is greater than or equal to the size of the imported image file. Valid values:

When N=1, the value indicates the system disk. Valid values: 1 GiB to 2048 GiB.
When N=2 to 17, the value indicates a data disk. Valid values: 1 GiB to 2048 GiB.

After you upload the source image file to OSS, you can view the image file size in the OSS bucket.

This parameter will be deprecated. For better compatibility, use `DiskDeviceMapping.N.DiskImageSize` instead
fields.help_zh:
自定义镜像大小。单位：GiB。

该空间由系统盘和数据盘组成，您必须保证系统盘的空间大小大于等于导入的镜像文件大小。取值范围：

N=1时，表示系统盘，取值范围：1 GiB~2048 GiB。
N=2~17时，表示数据盘。取值范围：1 GiB~2048 GiB。

当您将源镜像文件上传至OSS后，可以在OSS Bucket中查看镜像文件的大小。

该参数即将被弃用，为提高兼容性，请尽量使用`DiskDeviceMapping.N.DiskImageSize`参数
fields.name: disk_im_size

fields.help_en:
The space size of the custom image after the image is imported.

The space consists of the system disk and data disks. Make sure that the system disk space is greater than or equal to the size of the imported image file. Valid values:

When N=1, the value indicates the system disk. Valid values: 1 GiB to 2048 GiB.
When N=2 to 17, the value indicates a data disk. Valid values: 1 GiB to 2048 GiB.

After you upload the source image file to OSS, you can view the image file size in the OSS bucket
fields.help_zh:
导入镜像后，自定义镜像的空间大小。

该空间由系统盘和数据盘组成，您必须保证系统盘的空间大小大于等于导入的镜像文件大小。取值范围：

N=1时，表示系统盘，取值范围：1 GiB~2048 GiB。
N=2~17时，表示数据盘。取值范围：1 GiB~2048 GiB。

当您将源镜像文件上传至OSS后，可以在OSS Bucket中查看镜像文件的大小
fields.name: disk_image_size

parameters.help_en:
The image detection strategy. If this parameter is not specified, detection is not triggered. Only the Standard detection mode is supported.

Most Linux/Windows versions are supported. For more information about image detection items and operating system limitations, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/439819.html and https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/475800.html
parameters.help_zh:
镜像检测策略，不配置此参数时不触发检测。仅支持标准（Standard）检测模式。

目前已支持大部分的Linux/Windows版本，关于镜像检测项与操作系统限制说明，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/439819.html和https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/475800.html
parameters.name: detection_strategy

parameters.help_en:
The Alibaba Cloud Resource Name (ARN) of the CloudBox, which uniquely identifies the cloud storage location.

You need to specify this parameter only when you import an image file from OSS on CloudBox. If you are not using OSS on CloudBox, do not set this parameter. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/430190.html.

The correct ARN format is: `arn:acs:cloudbox:{RegionId}:{AliUid}:cloudbox/{CloudBoxId}`, where `{RegionId}` is the region ID where the CloudBox resides, `{AliUid}` is the Alibaba Cloud account ID, and `{CloudBoxId}` is the CloudBox ID
parameters.help_zh:
指定云盒的资源名称（ARN），用于唯一标识云端存储位置。

仅当您需要从OSS ON云盒中导入镜像文件时，才需提供此参数的值。如果您使用的存储服务不是OSS ON云盒，则无需设置此参数。更多信息，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/430190.html。

正确的ARN格式应遵循：`arn:acs:cloudbox:{RegionId}:{AliUid}:cloudbox/{CloudBoxId}`的模式，其中`{RegionId}`应替换为云盒实际所在的地域ID，`{AliUid}`是阿里云账号（主账号）ID，而`{CloudBoxId}`是云盒ID
parameters.name: storage_location_arn

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to perform only a dry run. Valid values:

true: performs only a dry run. The system checks the request for potential issues, including the AccessKey validity, the authorization of the Resource Access Management (RAM) user, and required parameters. If the check fails, the corresponding error is returned. If the check succeeds, the `DryRunOperation` error code is returned.
false: performs a dry run and sends the Normal request. If the check succeeds, a 2XX HTTP status code is returned and the operation is performed.

Default value: false
parameters.help_zh:
是否只预检此次请求。取值范围：

true：发送检查请求，不会查询资源状况。检查项包括AccessKey是否有效、RAM用户的授权情况和是否填写了必需参数。如果检查不通过，则返回对应错误。如果检查通过，则返回错误码`DryRunOperation`。
false：发送正常请求，通过检查后返回 2XX HTTP状态码并直接查询资源状况。

默认值：false
parameters.name: dry_run

fields.help_en:
The metadata access mode of the image. Valid values:
v1: When you create an ECS instance from this image, you cannot set the metadata access mode to "hardened mode only".
v2: When you create an ECS instance from this image, you can set the metadata access mode to "hardened mode only".

Default value: v1
fields.help_zh:
镜像的元数据访问模式，可能值：
v1：通过该镜像创建ECS实例时，不支持将元数据访问模式设置为“仅加固模式”。
v2：通过该镜像创建ECS实例时，支持将元数据访问模式设置为“仅加固模式”。

默认值：v1
fields.name: imds_support

fields.help_en:
Specifies whether the image supports NVMe.

supported: The image has the NVMe driver installed.
unsupported: The image does not have the NVMe driver installed.
If this parameter is not specified or the value is empty, the default value is unsupported.
By default, imported images are considered as not supporting the NVMe protocol. If you plan to run the image on instance types that support NVMe (such as c8i and r9i), make sure that the image has a built-in NVMe driver and explicitly set this parameter to supported
fields.help_zh:
镜像是否支持NVMe。

supported：镜像已安装 NVMe 驱动。
unsupported：镜像未安装 NVMe 驱动。
不传此参数或值为空时，默认值为 unsupported。
默认情况下，导入的镜像将被视为不支持 NVMe 协议。如果您计划在支持 NVMe 的实例规格（如 c8i、r9i 等）上运行该镜像，请务必确保镜像已内建NVMe驱动并显式设置为 supported
fields.name: nvme_support

parameters.help_en: The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request. You can use the client to generate the token, but make sure that the token is unique among different requests. The ClientToken value can contain only ASCII characters and cannot exceed 64 characters in length. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25693.html
parameters.help_zh: 保证请求幂等性。从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。ClientToken只支持ASCII字符，且不能超过64个字符。更多信息，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25693.html
parameters.name: client_token
